objective_equivalence_tolerances.source: maximum recorded primary tolerance among proven exact endpoints

dominance_rule: two-objective minimization with the recorded exact-endpoint absolute tolerances; equivalent endpoint allocations are counted once
classification_scope: current-known non-dominated union only; no universal full-front configuration claim is made
singleton_front_rule: coincident proven minimum-cost and minimum-time allowed endpoints imply a singleton objective-space front within tolerance, but not a unique allocation configuration
decomposition_identity: NY/NJ contribution + West Coast contribution + other contribution = allowed minus restricted quantity-weighted mean delivery time
decomposition_scope: proven exact minimum-time endpoints; shipment-matched, not unique freight-unit lineage
